summary: Short focused test of the SVG flag fix (emoji flags replaced by country-flag-icons). Everything passed. Drawer CityCard h3 has <svg data-testid=country-flag> (about 33x22, title=country) and its innerText has no regional-indicator characters. Checked on 22 cities across 20 countries via preset London, ArrowRight and Shuffle. The share dialog export canvas (city-export-canvas) shows 1 svg flag and no RI characters. Download PNG works for Square (1080x1080) and Story (1080x1920), and the Argentina flag shows up in both downloaded PNGs (opened and looked at). Static check: all 82 countries in global_rent_data.json map to an ISO code, and all 82 codes exist in country-flag-icons/react/3x2. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/flags.js flagOf() (emoji generator) is now unused - can be removed.
Flag returns null for unmapped countries silently; fine since all 82 are mapped, but new data countries must be added to ISO map.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flag svg: [data-testid=country-flag] inside drawer h3, title child = country name. BottomDock (shuffle-cities-button) is hidden while a city drawer is selected - close the drawer (visible [data-testid*=close]) before clicking Shuffle. Share format radios: share-format-square-radio / share-format-story-radio; download: download-card-png-button (triggers a real download event).
